description: CTAG, PSA and Vigo City Council publish observations from human-factor tests at the CTAG proving grounds. An autonomous vehicle circles a traffic-light scenario, adapts speed to the signal and brakes for a vulnerable road user detected through an IoT-connected camera. The described streams include CAN vehicle state and dynamics, driver brake/steering/throttle actions, absolute and relative environment-sensor coordinates, GPS and messages from the vehicle unit, server and roadside traffic-light/camera unit. These are bounded scenario logs for evaluating connected-driving behaviour, not a citywide traffic census. Source metadata do not establish detection-error distributions, complete sensor synchronization or a uniform sampling rate. The related Vigo valet-parking deposit concerns an indoor parking scenario and remains a separate resource. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
